text:
sofia: Quick heads-up — we need runway for the Q3 launch. Opening a quota/capacity ask for dedicated pools across multiple regions.
raj: Can you post expected model mix + concurrency and timeline?
sofia: Short answer: two production variants — a latency-first chat model and a cheaper long-context generator. Expect steady-state ~60 A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west1, 15-20 in us-east1. We want burst capacity to ~120 A100-eq in us-west1 for the 10-day launch window. Timeline target: 2026-07-15 to 2026-07-25 for the hard spike.
mike: Do we have token/SLO numbers? That affects batch sizing and whether autoscaler can avoid a full quota bump.
sofia: SLOs: 300ms p95 for chat; typical request ~150 tokens. Expected per-GPU concurrency ~20 requests for chat model, lower for generator. Cost note: we'll run cheaper quantized variants for steady and full precision for burst.
anna: If we can, prefer soft pre-warming (start instances earlier) + short-term quota increase rather than long-term commit. Cloud quota increases still need 48-72h to approve in some regions.
sofia: Agreed. Planning to request temporary quota for the burst window and permanent increase for steady-state. Also need network quota bumps (ENIs and external IPs) and regional routing capacity so we don't OOM NAT gates.
raj: Please include specific numbers in the ticket. Also list fallback plan — which models to degrade to if quotas aren't approved.
sofia: Will do. Drafting support payload now.
sofia: ```
Project: redwood-prod
Environment: dedicated/gpu-pools
Primary contact: sofia@redwood.com
Regions and requested changes:
- us-west1 (primary): A100 GPUs: current 40 -> requested 120 (steady 60 + burst 60)
- us-east1 (secondary): A100 GPUs: current 10 -> requested 20 (steady 15 + buffer 5)
- External IPv4 addresses: current 40 -> requested 120
- ENI / vNICs: +200
- vCPUs (for k8s nodes): +480
- Regional egress bandwidth: 10 Gbps -> 25 Gbps
Reason: Q3 product launch with expected 2x baseline traffic and short 10-day peak requiring burst pool.
Start window: 2026-07-13 (pre-warm)
Peak window: 2026-07-15 -> 2026-07-25
End window / rollback: 2026-07-27
Cost approval: pending finance sign-off (cc finance@redwood.com)
Fallback plan: degrade to 8k token gen / route chat to smaller quantized model if full quota denied.
```
raj: Looks good. Add estimated sustained cost delta for the steady pool vs. burst so finance can triage.
sofia: Estimated steady monthly incremental: ~$45k for dedicated steady pool. Burst window adds a ~$25k one-time spend. Will attach spreadsheet.
miranda: cc'ing finance now. Also, can we request tagged reservations so billing is traceable?
sofia: Yes — will include billing tag: redwood:q3-launch:prod.
infra-bot: Created internal tracking ticket INF-1242 and cloud support case CS-5876. Quota request payload attached to CS-5876.
cloud-support: Received. Ticket CS-5876 assigned to quota team. Typical approval ETA 48-96 hours; for accelerated review please include expected business impact and contact phone.
anna: If approval looks slow, we can split the change: scale ENIs/EIPs first and pre-warm a small subset to absorb initial users.
mike: Also consider temporarily moving batch-heavy jobs (non-prod) to other regions to free vCPUs.
sofia: Good call. I'll coordinate with platform runbook to pre-warm + shift non-prod.
miranda: Finance replied: provisional approval for steady pool spend; ask for final numbers once quota confirmed. :thumbsup:
sofia: Thanks — filing final ticket now and will ping again when CS-5876 is updated.
raj: Nice work. Keep ops on standby for the pre-warm dates.
sofia: Will do.
miranda: tagging on-call infra for the pre-warm start: @mike @raj
mike: Got it, will monitor.
sofia: closing loop here — will update thread once cloud-support responds with confirmed quotas and limits.
